01 — About

Built on discipline.
Driven by curiosity.

I'm a 21-year-old builder from Indonesia who treats design like an engineering problem and engineering like a design problem. My obsession is shipping work that's both fast and beautiful.

While most of my peers were waiting for the right moment, I started building. I taught myself Make.com from scratch, designed landing pages that convert, and learned the unglamorous parts — Telegram Bot tokens, Gmail module configs, mobile browser quirks — by just doing the work.

Now I help clients turn ideas into live products: clean websites, smart automations, and digital systems that pay for themselves.

03 — Why work with me

Six reasons clients
keep coming back.

Pixel-perfect execution

Designs that match the spec down to the last padding value — no "close enough".

Mobile-first by default

70% of your traffic is mobile. I design for the small screen first, then scale up.

Performance optimized

Lighthouse scores above 90 across the board. Fast sites convert more — period.

SEO-ready structure

Semantic HTML, proper heading hierarchy, and meta tags built in from day one.

Clear communication

Daily progress updates, no jargon, no ghosting. You'll always know where we stand.

On-time delivery

Realistic timelines, locked deadlines. If I commit to Friday, it ships Friday.
